title: Engine Facit
description: The single source of truth for what the engine is: epics -> stories -> acceptance criteria, in conceptual vocabulary. No markdown; this JSON is canonical. IDs are unique, immutable, and parent-bound (E{n}.S{k}.A{m}); k and m are assigned once at creation and never renumber, so the lock and the AC->test map key on them safely.

scope.description: What this facit specifies and where it sits in the composable tree. The facit is build-outable: an app facit (a whole single-scope application), an engine facit (generic), a domain facit per domain, a target facit per target, and a utility facit per shared utility. A utility is a reusable, OPTIONAL helper a scope may RECOMMEND; it is not bound to a domain. IDs (E{n}.S{k}.A{m}) are local to each facit; qualify globally by scope.

domain.description: Required when level is domain or target (e.g. apimapping).

target.description: Required when level is target (e.g. openapi-export).

utility.description: Required when level is utility (e.g. crawl, fetch-crawl-data).

extends.description: Scope ref of the parent facit this builds on: a domain facit extends "engine"; a target facit extends its domain (e.g. "domain:apimapping"); the engine facit and a standalone utility facit extend null.

uses.description: Dependency declaration, for a target facit: the variations it REQUIRES (must be satisfied to be downloadable) and the utilities it RECOMMENDS (optional shared helpers to acquire/prepare its input). References by id into the variation and utility catalogs.

requiredVariations.description: Variation ids this target requires (must be confirmed for the target to be downloadable).

optionalVariations.description: Variation ids this target consumes when confirmed to enrich its output, but does not require (their absence never blocks download).

recommendedUtilities.description: Utility ids this target recommends (optional helpers, e.g. crawl).

preamble.description: The framing prose: what this facit specifies. Conceptual vocabulary only.

id.description: Stable epic id, e.g. E1. Never renumbered.

notes.description: Epic-level closing cross-reference notes (e.g. which epic owns a mechanic referenced here).

id.description: Unique, immutable, parent-bound, e.g. E1.S3. The S{k} is assigned once and frozen.

notes.description: Cross-reference notes and illustrative examples that accompany the story.

id.description: Unique, immutable, parent-bound, e.g. E1.S3.A4. The A{m} is assigned once and frozen.

text.description: The full criterion, verbatim, in Given/When/Then form.
